regime_context: The Canada/TSX narrative rotation detector shows Big Banks as the dominant leader with full breadth and mixed durability, but high crowding and a wide margin over Pipelines; one-narrative is false. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdowns (gate_helps: true) and is actively filtering themes, while momentum ranks serve only as a focus lens with no forward alpha.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream: currently the challenger with a wide margin (0.802). Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff — if Pipelines overtakes Big Banks in score and durability improves, it could reshape the theme landscape. Kill criterion: margin widens beyond 1.0 and Pipelines’ breadth or durability deteriorates relative to Big Banks.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks exhibit the strongest thematic momentum (rank 1) with complete breadth and durable staying power, passing the absolute-trend gate. The overweight is rooted in trend-following discipline, but high crowding (z=1.59) caps sizing — not fades — and the lean assumes no loss of leadership or trend integrity.
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger sharp reversals on any macro shock (e.g., housing credit risk, rate surprises); the mixed Hurst tag signals trend stability is not uniform, and a sudden risk-off move could hit banks despite domestic resilience.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks lose leadership (rotation leader changes to another theme with a negative margin) OR durability_bar drops below 0.60 and breadth falls below 0.8 simultaneously.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples & Retail shows weak thematic momentum (rank 7, low score 0.088), a low durability bar (0.56), and a mean-reverting Hurst signature — indicating no reliable trend. The absolute-trend gate allows it (eligible), but the momentum focus lens suggests it is not attracting capital flow, justifying an underweight relative to stronger themes.
theses.dissent: Defensive rotation triggered by high unscheduled macro surprise share (0.64) or recession fears could lift staples; mean-reversion itself might work in its favor, and the broad breadth could serve as a foundation if the durability improves quickly.

falsifier.text: If Consumer Staples & Retail's durability_bar exceeds 0.65 AND its rank moves into the top 5, reversing the weak-trend thesis.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible: false) — the only validated drawdown-control edge for this market. Despite a trend-like Hurst tag and decent breadth, gate failure means the detector recommends avoiding exposure to reduce volatility and shake-outs, irrespective of narrative potential.
theses.dissent: Technology could rebound strongly on AI-driven sentiment or global risk-on moves; its trend Hurst and high breadth suggest underlying strength that might survive the gate filter in the next re-evaluation, making avoidance a temporary drag.

falsifier.text: If Technology becomes eligible (eligible flips to true) at the next detector update.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
